title: Show HN: I'm a 15 Year Old Wannabe Engineer, This Is a Cycloidal Gearbox I Built
summary: A 15-year-old aspiring engineer shares their self-designed and built cycloidal gearbox project, demonstrating impressive hands-on mechanical engineering skills through CAD design and 3D printing fabrication.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the design and fabrication process of a cycloidal gearbox as a practical learning project.
why_valuable: Shows exceptional initiative and practical skills from a young maker, inspiring others to pursue engineering projects regardless of age.
